hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: target_directory
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: 1st level prefix after bucket_s3_name Ex: imaging_aric

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
# guard: must start with "imaging" if [[ "$target_directory" != imaging* ]]; then echo "Error: target_directory must start with 'imaging'" >&2 exit 1 fi
# now it’s safe to delete aws s3 rm "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${target_directory}/rawData/" --recursive
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
